svg.text: Bits read RH, P ≠ NP, NS, YM, Hodge, BSD, Poincaré from left to right; gold is all seven, violet is Poincaré alone. Every pattern is realized, so the seven bits are

svg.text: independent: a principle delivering all seven rejects the other 127 patterns and carries a key on every row, and the Poincaré bit settles no other.
